contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #164: Hindman’s finite sums and products conjecture.

Uniform rough-step removal on a fixed connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group quotient G/Gamma: for every eta>0 and every allowed data sequence, the density of t admitting discrepancy at least eta tends to zero, with boxes, residues and bounded Lipschitz tests chosen separately for every t.

definitions.scales: w tends to infinity; W is the product of primes at most w; W divides the w-smooth integer L; S tends to infinity; S/L tends to infinity; Z/S^a tends to infinity for every fixed a>0.
definitions.polynomial: log P_t(x) has real coordinates jointly polynomial in (t,x), total degree at most fixed D, with arbitrary sequence-dependent coefficients.
definitions.adaptive_tests: Q is any axis-parallel box in [-CZ,CZ]^d with each side at least cZ; b is any integer vector; F has supremum norm plus Lipschitz seminorm at most B.
definitions.discrepancy: absolute difference of normalized averages of F(P_t(x)Gamma) over Q intersect Z^d and Q intersect (b+t Z^d).

contexts.statement: Finite-power extension of the full adaptive rough-step removal theorem on a fixed nilmanifold. The original spatial superpolynomial assumption is replaced explicitly, not assumed in addition.

definitions.fixed_data: G/Gamma is connected simply connected nilpotent, dimension n>=1, step at most fixed integer s>=1; d>=1,D>=1,c,C,B,kappa>0 are fixed; logarithmic coordinates and a smooth quotient metric are fixed.
definitions.scales: w tends to infinity; W=product of primes at most w divides w-smooth L; S tends to infinity; S/L tends to infinity; Z>=kappa*S^(2*D*s^(n-1)+2) eventually.
definitions.rough_steps: T=[S,2S) intersect (r+L Z), gcd(r,W)=1, and r may vary with the sequence index.
definitions.polynomial: log P_t(x) is jointly polynomial in (t,x) of total degree at most D, with arbitrary sequence-dependent coefficients.
definitions.bad_step: there exist a box Q in [-CZ,CZ]^d with every side at least cZ, b in Z^d, and a complex F of supremum-plus-Lipschitz norm at most B, such that the normalized unrestricted and step-t averages differ by at least a fixed eta>0. These witnesses can vary separately for each t.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 164 (Hindman’s finite sums and products conjecture.; papers: Monochromatic finite sums and products in the positive integers; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
For every finite coloring and m,R,D there are separated a_1<...<a_m whose nonempty subset sums and products all have one color; separation is a_1>R and a_d>R(sum_{k<d}a_k+prod_{k<d}a_k)^D.
Prediction principle pr:prediction: calibrated bounded-step piecewise nilsequence models approximate the weighted simultaneous sum/product count.
Alignment principle pr:alignment: a positive uniform alignment mass for admissible models, obtained using finite word recurrence, cube symmetries, and removal of tail-product sampling factors.
lem:chain-selection: a sufficiently long product list has an m-block chain whose nonempty block-products have one color.
lem:master-scales and prop:linear-forms provide admissible arithmetic scales, prime-pool/divisibility control, and weighted linear-forms estimates.
prop:correlation-test: uniform weighted correlation control after prime insertion, mask removal, polynomial-direction reduction, and additive elimination.
lem:dual-pseudorandomness and prop:dense-model give bounded dense models tested by lem:nilsequence-testing.
prop:local-cube-law and prop:face-lift give local cube laws and lift marginal face symmetries to joint configurations.
lem:finite-word-plan converts nilpotent polynomial recurrence into finitely many scale updates and jumps.
cor:rough-residual-step removes one factor t from a fixed retained class modulo q, without requiring gcd(q,t)=1.
Proposition prop:rough-step with its full sequential uniformity over jointly log-polynomial coefficients and per-step adaptive boxes, residues, and bounded Lipschitz tests.
A positive-density exceptional set contains every fixed length of progression with smooth difference; finite color refinements preserve arbitrarily long bad progression families.
A bad progression family descends to one of finitely many fixed rational kernel nilmanifolds of smaller dimension, with all new analytic constants independent of progression length.
Haar discrepancy on a comparable box yields a common bounded horizontal character and monomial coefficient obstructions, uniformly in polynomial coefficients.
A logarithmic polynomial of ordinary total degree D is polynomial for the fixed stretched lower-central filtration of degree sD.
Exact division interpolation has an H-independent error constant; only its smooth denominators and asymptotic exactness threshold depend on the fixed progression length H.
Rational gap forcing, polynomial linear-factor exact division, coprime-denominator cancellation, and orientation-correct group kernel factorization.

Horizontal splitting gives a kernel log-polynomial of degree at most sD; the quotient lattices depend only on a fixed finite character list and finitely many residues, not on interpolation denominators.
Freezing on boundedly many subboxes and splitting modulo fixed K preserves a fixed discrepancy; the CRT reparametrization retains the original step t.
External input: corrected quantitative Leibman theorem on equal-side boxes, with a fixed rational adapted basis and coefficient-independent constants.
External input: finite Szemeredi theorem; finite van der Waerden follows by taking density 1/number_of_colors.

External rational nilpotent Lie-group structure: rational connected subgroups meet lattices in lattices, rational conjugation preserves the rational structure, and BCH is a finite rational Lie polynomial.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace RoughStep

open Polynomial

theorem rational_gap (N k : ℤ) (r : ℚ) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hclear : (N : ℚ) * r = k) (hsmall : |(N : ℚ) * r| < 1) :
    r = 0 := by
  rw [hclear] at hsmall
  have hk : |k| < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hsmall
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
  have hz : (N : ℚ) * r = 0 := by simpa [hk0] using hclear
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast hN)

theorem integral_of_coprime_multiples (d t n k : ℤ) (r : ℚ)
    (hcop : IsCoprime d t) (hd : (d : ℚ) * r = n)
    (ht : (t : ℚ) * r = k) :
    ∃ j : ℤ, r = j := by
  rcases hcop with ⟨u, v, huv⟩
  refine ⟨u * n + v * k, ?_⟩
  have huvq : (u : ℚ) * d + (v : ℚ) * t = 1 := by exact_mod_cast huv
  calc
    r = ((u : ℚ) * d + (v : ℚ) * t) * r := by rw [huvq]; ring
    _ = (u : ℚ) * ((d : ℚ) * r) + (v : ℚ) * ((t : ℚ) * r) := by ring
    _ = ((u * n + v * k : ℤ) : ℚ) := by rw [hd, ht]; push_cast; ring

theorem linear_power_dvd_of_hasse_jets (R : ℚ[X]) (a : ℚ) (e : ℕ)
    (hjets : ∀ j < e, (hasseDeriv j R).eval a = 0) :
    (X - C a) ^ e ∣ R := by
  apply X_sub_C_pow_dvd_iff.mpr
  rw [← taylor_apply]
  apply X_pow_dvd_iff.mpr
  intro j hj
  rw [taylor_coeff]
  exact hjets j hj

theorem exact_linear_division (R : ℚ[X]) (t₀ m : ℚ) (e : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (hjets : ∀ j < e, (hasseDeriv j R).eval (-t₀ / m) = 0) :
    ∃ M : ℚ[X], R = (C t₀ + C m * X) ^ e * M := by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := linear_power_dvd_of_hasse_jets R (-t₀ / m) e hjets
  have hma : m * (-t₀ / m) = -t₀ := by field_simp
  have hlinear : C t₀ + C m * X = C m * (X - C (-t₀ / m)) := by
    rw [mul_sub, ← C_mul, hma, C_neg]
    ring
  have hunit : C m * C m⁻¹ = (1 : ℚ[X]) := by
    rw [← C_mul]
    simp [hm]
  refine ⟨C m⁻¹ ^ e * Q, ?_⟩
  calc
    R = (X - C (-t₀ / m)) ^ e * Q := hQ
    _ = (C m * C m⁻¹) ^ e * ((X - C (-t₀ / m)) ^ e * Q) := by
      rw [hunit]
      simp
    _ = (C m * (X - C (-t₀ / m))) ^ e * (C m⁻¹ ^ e * Q) := by
      rw [mul_pow]
      ring
    _ = (C t₀ + C m * X) ^ e * (C m⁻¹ ^ e * Q) := by rw [hlinear]

theorem residue_class_exists (K t u b : ℤ) (hcop : IsCoprime K t) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, t ∣ u + K * a - b := by
  rcases hcop with ⟨p, q, hpq⟩
  refine ⟨p * (b - u), -q * (b - u), ?_⟩
  linear_combination (b - u) * hpq

theorem residue_reparametrization (K t u b a y : ℤ)
    (hcop : IsCoprime K t) (ha : t ∣ u + K * a - b) :
    t ∣ u + K * y - b ↔ t ∣ y - a := by
  rcases hcop with ⟨p, q, hpq⟩
  rcases ha with ⟨h, hh⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨p * (k - h) + q * (y - a), ?_⟩
    linear_combination (y - a) * hpq - p * hk + p * hh
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨h + K * k, ?_⟩
    linear_combination hh + K * hk

theorem descent_exponent_invariant (n s D : ℕ) :
    2 * (s * D) * s ^ n + 2 = 2 * D * s ^ (n + 1) + 2 := by
  rw [pow_succ]
  ring

section Groups

variable {G A : Type*} [Group G] [Group A]

theorem kernel_membership (χ : G →* A) (v : A →* G)
    (hsection : ∀ u, χ (v u) = u) (a m : A) (p : G)
    (hχ : χ p = a * m) :
    χ (v a⁻¹ * p * v m⁻¹) = 1 := by
  simp [hsection, hχ, mul_assoc]

theorem kernel_factorization (v : A →* G) (a m : A) (p : G) :
    v a * (v a⁻¹ * p * v m⁻¹) * v m = p := by
  simp [mul_assoc]

theorem periodic_right_factor (Γ : Subgroup G) (g : G) (K j k : ℤ)
    (hK : g ^ K ∈ Γ) :
    ∃ γ ∈ Γ, g ^ (j + K * k) = g ^ j * γ := by
  refine ⟨(g ^ K) ^ k, Γ.zpow_mem hK k, ?_⟩
  rw [zpow_add, zpow_mul]

end Groups

end RoughStep

external_assumptions.locator: Theorem 1.2, pp. 466-467; Theorem 1.1 for the coloring consequence

external_assumptions.statement: For a fixed rational filtered nilmanifold, fixed variable count and accuracy, failure of equidistribution on an equal-side integer cube yields a nonzero horizontal character from a fixed finite list with bounded binomial C-infinity norm, independently of polynomial coefficients and cube size.
external_assumptions.source: Green and Tao, expanded erratum, corrected Theorem 8.6, equal sides only. Original unequal-side assertion without an extra alternative is not used.
external_assumptions.locator: Introduction, corrected [GT, Theorem 8.6], equal-sides sentence; Section 3

external_assumptions.statement: A nilmanifold admits a rational Malcev basis adapted to a rational filtration; a rational connected subgroup with rational filtration has a Malcev basis for its intersection lattice.
external_assumptions.source: Green and Tao, The quantitative behaviour of polynomial orbits on nilmanifolds; definitions/remarks and construction of subnilmanifold bases.
external_assumptions.locator: Definition 2.1 and its Remarks; Proposition A.10

external_assumptions.statement: For a step-s nilpotent Lie algebra, BCH is a finite rational sum of nested brackets of length at most s; conversion between exponential and nested Malcev coordinates is polynomial and rational for a rational nested basis.
external_assumptions.source: Green and Tao, The quantitative behaviour of polynomial orbits on nilmanifolds, coordinate lemmas and the BCH formula in their proof.
external_assumptions.locator: Lemma A.2(i) and its proof; Lemma A.3

routes.retired_because: The corrected equidistribution theorem only supplies a horizontal obstruction. It does not establish progression-length-independent interpolation, adaptive sampling, or noncommutative kernel descent, so citing it alone cannot close prop:rough-step.
